Interface ConfigurationProvider

All Superinterfaces:
MethodBasedProvider<SequentialExecutionConfiguration>
All Known Implementing Classes:
DelegatingConfigurationProvider
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ConfigurationProvider extends MethodBasedProvider<SequentialExecutionConfiguration>
An ConfigurationProvider is responsible for providing exactly one SequentialExecutionConfiguration for use in a CombinatorialTest.

To register a ConfigurationProvider, use the ConfigurationSource annotation as demonstrated by ConfigurationFromMethod.

Implementations must provide a no-args constructor.

This is more or less a copy of org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ArgumentsProvider from the junit-jupiter-params project.
